name: Saori Asumi
source:
With the qualities of a princess, Saori is elegant, humble, and motherly. She has won the hearts of many with her musical talent and her sweet smile. She learned to play the violin at a young age and now she is challenging herself to play the piano on her own time. 
Although Saori doesn't know anything about Kazu's tragic accident, they quickly become friends and she tries her best to help him.
translation:
With the qualities of a princess, Saori is elegant, humble, and motherly. She has won the hearts of many with her musical talent and her sweet smile. She learned to play the violin at a young age and now she is challenging herself to play the piano on her own time. 
Although Saori doesn't know anything about Kazu's tragic accident, they quickly become friends and she tries her best to help him.
